name: Zul'Gurub: Venoxis evades once he is pulled past the tester's leash line
contract: High Priest Venoxis (14507) must reset once he is pulled past the spot the tester marked (round 11,
2026-11-20: -11992.385, -1657.1074). The leash is a straight line through that mark, perpendicular to the
direction from his home (-12029.8, -1707.9) to the mark; the far side is outside his room, so the engine's
boundary check evades him. In a fresh Normal instance the hero stands 15 yards past the mark along that
direction, summons Venoxis next to them and pulls him; within two boundary checks (2.5 s each) he evades.

steps.label: The hero stands 15 yards past the leash mark, away from his home
CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub on Normal
CONTROL: the hero stands on the ground by Venoxis's pool
DISCRIMINATING: Venoxis evades past his leash line
